source: E&SMB-BO To-Be Process, profiling, pages 12-13 (photographed), plus product-owner requests

steps.step: Customer logs in and places a request with the conversational chatbot
tests: a new customer starts with a name and a company
a new customer introduces themselves, attaches the documents
steps.note: The B2B portal login is not modelled; the chat is the portal. Sessions are cookie-based and synthetic.

steps.step: Chatbot analyses the customer intent and asks for the required valid information
tests: greets a new customer and asks for a name and a company
steps.note: Intent is fixed to New LOA (deterministic name/company extraction, no model); other intents in the diagrams are out of scope.

steps.step: Customer needs further guidance? Customer provides the chatbot with the details
tests: asks only for what is missing, over several turns

steps.step: Chatbot connects the customer with a human agent; the human agent creates the ticket
tests: a company that is NOT on record becomes a new lead
a company that is not on record is confirmed first and becomes a new lead with onboarding pending
steps.note: A company that is not on record gets a new-lead case and a specialist follow-up; nothing is verified or approved. There is no live human hand-over.

steps.step: Converts the request into a ticket and creates it in BCRM
tests: a company on record: opens a case and asks for the Emirates ID
steps.note: BCRM is replaced by the case store (AUTH-101, AUTH-102, ...).

steps.step: Validates the request and asks for / collects the documents (Emirates ID, Trade License, Establishment Card)
tests: missing documents are named and the same request stays open
after three attempts that still miss documents
documents in different formats (a Word file and two PDFs)
steps.note: Documents are the only evidence (PDF, Word, images); typed text is refused.

steps.step: Triggers SBO.02 for New LOA Processing
tests: Fatima (licence owner, valid documents): all five checks pass in order

steps.step: Documents not uploaded / discrepancies: SBO.11 drafts an email for the pending information
tests: Omar (not the licence owner): a POA is requested
derives missing information, conflicts and a customer-safe summary
steps.note: The request is made in the chat itself; the drafted email is a draft only.

steps.step: Could not classify: route the request to the exception queue for manual review
tests: a known company but a person that is not in the identity register
lists every review with its case

steps.step: Triggers SBO.06 (Trade License Check agent) to perform the TL and EC checks
tests: exposes exactly the five specialist tools
exposes exactly the five specialist tools

steps.step: Extracts the EC and TL fields; matches the Establishment Card and Trade License name
tests: reads fields even when a PDF or OCR puts the whole document on one line

steps.step: Trade License not readable: perform the QR check
tests: Mariam: the licence number is unreadable, so the QR code is used
a licence with neither a readable number nor a QR code asks the customer

steps.step: Uses the DUL API to verify the TL details and structures the output
tests: Fatima (licence owner, valid documents): all five checks pass in order
steps.note: The DUL API is a synthetic register.

steps.step: DUL API failure: log in to the government portal with UAE Pass and validate the TL
tests: Noura: the DUL API is down
Noura: the DUL API is down
steps.note: No portal or UAE Pass call is made; the fallback path is modelled and reported as PASS_WITH_FLAG.

steps.step: Collects the output and decides the next step (stops at a terminal result)
tests: stops after a terminal result: later tools are refused
an explicit terminal business rule takes precedence
an LLM that forces APPROVE on an expired licence is overridden

steps.step: TL expired: reject the request, SBO.11 emails the customer, SBO.20 RCA agent analyses the reason
tests: %s → REJECT %s: stops at the failing check
steps.note: Every rejection waits for a human to confirm it on the review dashboard; the email is a draft and the RCA is a deterministic summary.

steps.step: Name does not match: reject the request (SBO.11 + SBO.20)
tests: the Emirates ID name must match the name in the request
%s → REJECT %s: stops at the failing check

steps.step: Triggers SBO.07 for identity validation
tests: an expired Emirates ID is a fixable gap

steps.step: Cross-checks the EID and EC with the TL name and returns a structured output
tests: Fatima (licence owner, valid documents): all five checks pass in order
a known company but a person that is not in the identity register

steps.step: EID, EC and TL name mismatch observed: reject
tests: %s → REJECT %s: stops at the failing check

steps.step: Triggers the POA/MOA workflow: document available? checks cleared / not cleared
tests: Omar (not the licence owner): a POA is requested
Hessa: acts under an expired POA

steps.step: Who is authorised without a POA/MOA (product owner rule): ID verified; recorded as owner, manager with representative authority or authorised signatory in the approved source; capacity covers the requested action; licence current and consistent; no conflicting evidence or limitation
tests: a manager recorded with full representative authority needs no POA
a manager whose recorded capacity does not cover every requested action still needs a POA
a person on the establishment card without a recorded authority
a recorded limitation or conflicting evidence on the person
steps.note: Broader than owner-only, narrower than anyone listed on the Establishment Card.

steps.step: Triggers SBO.09 for the bad-debt and blue-collar checks; SBO.08 cross-checks duplicate PDs in BCRM
tests: Layla: the bad-debt check sees the duplicate party IDs
steps.note: BCRM is a synthetic party register.

steps.step: No bad debt or blue-collar behaviour: SBO.02 triggers SBO.10 to run the AVCV (Address Verification and Credit Verification) workflow
tests: Fatima (licence owner, valid documents): all five checks pass in order
steps.note: AVCV is a synthetic register with one outcome for the address and one for the credit profile (positive, negative, discrepancy, unable to verify, refer, insufficient information); no field visit or bureau lookup happens.

steps.step: AVCV outcomes: only an adverse result is a rejection; a discrepancy, unable-to-verify or refer goes to a specialist; insufficient information asks for proof of address
tests: insufficient information for the address verification asks for proof of address
a proof of address held by someone else does not satisfy the verification

steps.step: AVCV successful: approve the request and SBO.11 shares the communication with the stakeholders
tests: approves only when every mandatory check passes (FINAL-001)
steps.note: The communication is a draft; nothing is sent and nothing is written to a production system.

steps.step: AVCV adverse: reject the request (SBO.11 + SBO.20)
tests: %s → REJECT %s: stops at the failing check

steps.step: A lookup that is unavailable or unmatched is never treated as proof of invalidity: a specialist decides
tests: a known company but a person that is not in the identity register

steps.step: The deterministic finalizer, not the model, issues every final outcome; the model only recommends
tests: is deterministic and contains no model dependency
an LLM that stops early and recommends APPROVE cannot override deterministic governance

steps.step: Runtime results are unique per case_run_id + submission_version + check_type
tests: the persisted result key is the three-part case_run_id + submission_version + check_type
rerunning the same utility is idempotent

steps.step: Customer documents are data, never instructions
tests: instructions written inside a document change nothing
a file that is none of the four supported document types

steps.step: Evidence is documents only: typed text is never accepted as evidence
tests: typed text can never become evidence, by any route
documents only: while a document request is open there is no text box

steps.step: Documents are attached in the same chat window (PDF, Word, images); a missing or replaced document is requested again in the same window
tests: Omar is not the licence owner
a POA is requested in the same conversation

steps.step: Review dashboard: every review with its Review ID, status, checks, documents and root-cause analysis
tests: lists every review on the dashboard
the dashboard lists the review with its Review ID

steps.step: Reopen a rejected or incomplete request from the review dashboard; the customer answers in the chat (replaces the resubmission page)
tests: a reviewer reopens a rejected case
reopening a rejected case creates a new version
reopen: the reviewer reopens a rejected case

steps.step: A company that is not on record is only a new lead: never approved
tests: a company that is NOT on record becomes a new lead
a company that is not on record becomes a new lead over HTTP

steps.step: The agent may recommend a rejection, but a rejection is never final or communicated externally without human confirmation
tests: a recommended rejection is never shown to the customer
drafts the email (SBO.11), requests root-cause analysis (SBO.20) and waits for a human
steps.note: The customer sees "awaiting specialist confirmation"; the reason and the decision are visible only on the review dashboard.

steps.step: Customer-facing request catalog: eight intent categories and every request type of the operating model (profiling, verifier task, processing), with a stage owner for each
tests: assigns request types to the stage that owns them

steps.step: Pre-populated standard queries and free-text intent recognition start a request in one step
tests: pre-populated standard queries start a request in one click
typing a request in your own words is recognised

steps.step: Requests that are not automated are captured and routed to the stage that owns them (profiling, verifier task, processing) — never checked, approved or changed
tests: a chosen request that is not automated is captured and routed
the operations overview counts captured requests per stage
the Operations page shows the six stages
steps.note: Only New LOA is automated. Control tower, governance and reporting are shown for the operating model only.

steps.step: A name that is not a full name is asked for again (first and last name) before anything is created
tests: a name that is not a full name is asked for again before anything is created

steps.step: A company that is not on record is confirmed with the customer before the lead is created; a confirmed lead is recorded with onboarding status PENDING and the customer is told a representative will get back
tests: a company that is not on record is confirmed with the customer first; a correction continues the normal flow
a confirmed lead is recorded with onboarding status PENDING, tells the customer a representative will get back, and never checks or approves
a company that is not on record is confirmed first and becomes a new lead with onboarding pending

steps.step: A human can reopen a closed case; a closed, human-confirmed rejection is reopened by the customer only once they furnish documents
tests: a human can reopen a closed (completed) rejected review from the dashboard
a closed, human-confirmed rejection is reopened by the customer only once they furnish documents; before confirmation nothing is offered

steps.step: The Operations page shows the operating-model stages as a stepper with the New LOA pipeline, new leads, captured requests and recent activity
tests: the Operations page shows the six stages of the operating model with only profiling live

steps.step: When only the key word (or a near miss) of a registered company name is typed, the chatbot asks "Did you mean …?" before creating anything
tests: only the key word (or a near miss) of a registered company asks "Did you mean …?" before anything is created
several close matches are listed and nothing is picked for the customer
only the key word of a company asks "Did you mean …?" once (the page polling never repeats it), and yes continues with that company

steps.step: A returning customer is told their case is already in progress (documents outstanding: carries on in the same case; with a specialist, approved or a pending lead: told so, no duplicate); a closed case is offered for reopening so the correct proof can be submitted
tests: a returning customer whose documents are still outstanding is told the case is already in progress and carries on in the same case
a returning customer whose case is with a specialist, already approved, or a pending lead is told so and no duplicate case is opened
a case closed by cancelling its document request is offered for reopening; yes resumes the same case, no leaves it closed
a returning customer is told the case is already in progress and carries on in the same case; a closed case is offered for reopening

steps.step: An authority document (POA/MOA/authorised-representative letter) is read clause by clause: company, representative, signatory, validity and every requested clause are checked; a fixable gap (name mismatch, wrong company, unrecorded signatory, expired, a clause not mentioned) is insufficient evidence — the customer is told exactly what is missing and asks to upload again (3 attempts, then a human)
tests: the n8n V1 letter (day-to-day only) is INSUFFICIENT
the n8n V2 letter (explicit clauses) is SUFFICIENT
a name mismatch is a sure-shot gap
n8n AUTH-003: V1 is read and found insufficient
a letter for the wrong person is asked for again with the reason
an authority letter that does not cover the requested clauses is read and asked for again with the exact gaps, instead of being rejected

steps.step: Only content that does not inspire confidence goes to a human: contradictory or limited authority, an embedded instruction, an unreadable document (specialist review); a withdrawn authority is a recommended rejection a human confirms
tests: a clause that is negated stays a gap
a limitation that needs interpreting, an embedded instruction
content that cannot be trusted goes to a human

steps.step: The supporting documents (Emirates ID, Trade License, Establishment Card, proof of address) get the same due diligence: required details present and valid, consistent with the request and with each other; a fixable gap is insufficient evidence (asked again with the exact reason, 3 attempts, then a human); register-verified adverse facts and untrustworthy content stay with the checks / a human

steps.step: Guided scenarios: realistic-format documents in flawed → corrected pairs (authority letters, Emirates ID, licence and card, proof of address, injection) replay end to end and are shown in the web app with their files
tests: each step ends where the script says
the scenarios are listed for the web app
a guided scenario: the wrong Emirates ID is explained and the right one is accepted

steps.step: Other To-Be processes: Mobile Re-Registration, Document Update, Combo (Document Update + LOA / LOA + Re-Registration), Regularization, PMP, TASK/TKT, Data Quality Assurance
steps.note: Only the New LOA chatbot-triggered process was built. The other diagrams reuse SBO.05 (document extraction), SBO.12 (system data check / reconciliation) and other utility agents that are not implemented.

steps.step: Automation of the verifier task (MNP, activations, transfer of ownership, SIM replacement, AVCV field work, legal letters, biometric verification), processing (order creation, quality checks, contract validation, delivery, lifecycle tracking), the control tower, governance and reporting
steps.note: Requests for these are captured and routed (T9); nothing runs on them.

steps.step: Ticket-triggered and channel-partner-triggered variants of New LOA; SBO.05 document extraction agent; SBO.13 order execution; SBO.14 case lifecycle tracking
